label: adaptive-gemini-flash
note: Illustrative stated starting points; live provider calls, no user Chart writes.

context.intention: I maintain a consistent workout routine.
context.actualStartingPoint: I exercise sporadically. I can use three 30-minute slots each week for bodyweight exercise at home.
context.destinationDescription: I maintain a consistent workout routine.

analysis.startingPointSummary: Exercises sporadically with three available 30-minute weekly slots for home bodyweight workouts.
assumptions: No specialized equipment or gym membership required.
The three 30-minute time slots are currently available in the user's weekly schedule.

routeDesign.complexityReason: Establishing a habit starting from sporadic exercise using explicitly available home time slots.
routeDesign.countReason: Three waypoints cover the necessary stages of habit formation: establishing a first workable week, proving adaptability through disruption, and sustaining consistency over time.

analysis.firstMilestoneEvidence: Completing all three 30-minute bodyweight sessions in a single week.

raw.destination: Maintain a consistent bodyweight workout routine with three 30-minute home sessions per week.

waypoints.title: Complete three bodyweight workouts in a single week
waypoints.rationale: Proves that three 30-minute home slots fit your actual weekly schedule.
waypoints.completionCriteria: Three 30-minute bodyweight sessions completed in one calendar week.

moves.title: Block out three 30-minute slots in your calendar
moves.rationale: Secures dedicated time in advance so workouts are scheduled rather than spontaneous.

moves.title: Choose 3-4 basic bodyweight exercises
moves.rationale: Keeps the workout straightforward without requiring extensive planning.

moves.title: Clear a dedicated workout space at home
moves.rationale: Removes physical friction before your first session starts.

waypoints.title: Adapt workouts through a disrupted week
waypoints.rationale: Tests habit resilience when routine schedules or energy levels shift.
waypoints.completionCriteria: All three workouts completed during a week with schedule interruptions.
requirements: Identify backup workout timeslots for the week
Complete a session using a backup time or adjusted format

moves.title: Define two alternative 30-minute slots for busy days
moves.rationale: Provides an immediate fallback if a primary slot gets canceled.

moves.title: Execute a modified 30-minute session during a busy day
moves.rationale: Maintains momentum even when circumstances are less than ideal.

moves.title: Log completed sessions immediately after finishing
moves.rationale: Reinforces consistency and provides immediate feedback.

waypoints.title: Sustain three weekly workouts for four weeks
waypoints.rationale: Solidifies bodyweight exercise as an automatic rhythm in your life.
waypoints.completionCriteria: Four consecutive weeks of completing three 30-minute workouts each week.

moves.title: Review weekly workout performance every Sunday
moves.rationale: Helps identify patterns and adjust time slots for the upcoming week.

moves.title: Prepare workout clothes and space the night before
moves.rationale: Lowers resistance on scheduled workout days.

moves.title: Keep a visual log of completed weeks
moves.rationale: Provides clear feedback on ongoing consistency.

suggestedOneMove.title: Block out three 30-minute slots in your calendar
suggestedOneMove.rationale: Secures dedicated time in advance so workouts are scheduled rather than spontaneous.

raw.personalizedGuidance: Focus on locking in your three weekly 30-minute slots at home before building intensity.
